description: Create a new billing project under one of your customers. The organization is fixed by your context; customer_id must be a customer in your organization. Discover ids with find_billing_work - never ask the user for an id.

billing_type.description: Billing type to allow on the project (required). One of: TM, Fix, OVH.

create_general_activity.description: Optional. When true (the default for this tool), also create a default visible "General" task + activity so time can be logged on the project immediately. Set false to create an empty project with no activities yet.

customer_id.description: Id of the customer this project belongs to (required). Must be a customer in your organization.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

name: create_project
